ar.title: رموش الست

steps.n1: يضاف البيكنج باودر للدقيق وذرة ملح.
steps.n2: يخفف السكر مع الزبدة بالمضرب حتى يصير مثل الكريمة، ثم يضاف دقيق السميد وجوز الهند مع التقليب الجيد.
steps.n3: يخفق بياض البيض مع الفانيليا ويقلب مع الخليط السابق.
steps.n4: يضاف للعجينة الدقيق ويعجن جيدا حتى يتجانس.
steps.n5: تقطع العجينة على شكل عيون وترص في صينية مدهونة زيت خفيف.
steps.n6: تدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى يتم النضج.
steps.n7: تسقى بالشراب البارد وترص في صحن التقديم.

en.title: Rimoush El Sett (Lady's Eyelashes)

steps.n1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
steps.n2: Cream the sugar and butter together with a whisk, then add the semolina and coconut, mixing well.
steps.n3: Whisk the egg whites with the vanilla and fold them into the previous mixture.
steps.n4: Add the flour to the dough and knead well until homogeneous.
steps.n5: Cut the dough into eye shapes and arrange them on a lightly greased baking tray.
steps.n6: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
steps.n7: Drizzle with cold simple syrup and arrange on a serving plate.

legacySteps: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
Cream the sugar and butter together with a whisk, then add the semolina and coconut, mixing well.
Whisk the egg whites with the vanilla and fold them into the previous mixture.
Add the flour to the dough and knead well until homogeneous.
Cut the dough into eye shapes and arrange them on a lightly greased baking tray.
Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
Drizzle with cold simple syrup and arrange on a serving plate.
